sentences.text:
The present Revision Petition has been filed on behalf of the father of the Complainant challenging the Judgment dated 22.03.2023 vide which Respondents No. 2 to 5 have been acquitted for the offence under Sections 302/498A/304B/34 IPC.
2.

Learned Counsel for the Respondents submits that Respondents No.2 & 3 have died on 09.06.2019 and 14.05.2021.
3.
None has appeared on behalf of the Petitioner.
4. The present Petition is accordingly dismissed in default and for non- prosecution.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J MAY 7, 2025 r
